findings.description: Clean architectural decoupling between Policy Engine, Capability Intelligence, Tool Selection, Provider Engine, Execution Runtime, Verification Engine, Evidence System, Release Governance, and Evolution Governance.
External write barrier strictly enforced: PRJ-FUNDACION remains 100% frozen with 0 files, 0 directories, and 0 write attempts across all tests and simulations.
PROPOSAL_ONLY boundary prevents self-authorized governance mutation; Product Owner Level 2+ authorization is required for rule elevation.
Adversarial Truth Principle and 15-scenario Game Day suite active, proving system resilience under controlled failure injection.
Synthetic Reality Gap: Guarantees are verified synthetically in local mode; live production LLM endpoints, real cloud deployment, and live commercial API credentials remain unconfigured.
Scoring Matrix Calibration: 12-dimensional tool scoring and 18-dimensional strategy scoring weights operate on ASSUMPTION tags prior to live telemetry collection.

Governance Complexity Growth: 6 state machines (Execution, Mission, Evolution, Operating Loop, Release, Game Day) require strict cross-state equivalence enforcement to prevent state machine explosion.
